findings.issue: EV-09 payload names approvalid, caseid, amount and level. None of these field names or the amount field appear in the item or the story sources.
AC16 and TC-E2-029-22 state a 200 'Already recorded' answer. No source gives that status code or text. The story only gives 409 for a different body.
Error paragraph still says every error has messageId set, but 401 and 404 now have no message ID. The sentence contradicts the edited entries.
Claims the screen specification gives the loading state, which no source supports. Also conflicts with R-18168, which says this story owns no screen and states belong to SCR-03's owner.
Contract version built against reads '/v1 path', which presents a URL segment as a contract version. DOR-23 says no version is in the sources.
